retrievalProfile.description: A 1980s studio portrait set against a minimalist, geometric interior featuring a stylized window view of a neon-pink city skyline.

recipe.visualDefinition: A man in a white blazer and pastel trousers leans against a stark white wall in a minimalist room. To the left, a large, angled geometric window reveals a vibrant pink sky and a black silhouette of a city skyline. The lighting is soft and directional, creating long, diffused shadows. The overall style combines clean studio photography with graphic, airbrushed elements typical of mid-80s pop culture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against a wall balanced by a large geometric window on the opposite side
High-contrast black city silhouette against a saturated pink background
Soft, diffused studio lighting casting long shadows on a white minimalist floor
Bold, condensed yellow typography overlapping a graphic blue and pink shape
coreInvariants: Angled geometric window frame with multiple panes
Saturated pink sky behind a black city silhouette
Soft airbrushed gradients on interior surfaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned on the right third of the frame, standing full-length at a medium scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright pink window on the left serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold yellow text at the top, moves down to the pink window, and then follows the floor line to the subject on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is provided by the white walls and floor, creating a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and off-white for the interior walls and floor.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for the city silhouette and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant neon pink for the sky and bright yellow for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the window and text contrasts with the high-value, low-saturation interior.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a minimalist white studio room with a large angled window on the left. Inside the window, show a black city silhouette against a neon pink sky. A man in a white 80s blazer stands on the right leaning against the wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-condensed yellow text with thick black outlines at the top left, overlapping a soft blue airbrushed shape and a wavy pink line.
